headline: Reserve Bank of India to Conduct Overnight Variable Rate Repo Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced it will conduct an Overnight Variable Rate Repo auction for a notified amount of 50,000 crore rupees on November 30, 2026.
why: Central bank liquidity operations are vital tools for managing short-term money market rates and banking system liquidity.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Repo auctions directly influence domestic banking system liquidity and short-term interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Variable rate repo auctions absorb or inject short-term liquidity, directly influencing interbank borrowing costs.
